verdict.line: You lose if you let his Tongue Lash stacks hit three and your Remove Scurvy is down when the stun lands; you win if you poke him down while his Abyssal Dive is on cooldown and deny the stack-stun-Devour combo.

brief.thesis: This matchup is decided by a stack counter, not a stat check: every landed Q (Tongue Lash) gives Tahm Kench a stack of An Acquired Taste, and at three stacks his next Q stuns you and lets him follow with R (Devour) for a burst kill. Your W (Remove Scurvy) clears that stun outright, so the lane is a race between his stack timer and your W cooldown. Overall this sits at 51% across 204 games — genuinely even, with the only real risk being a mistimed all-in window.

theirWindow.when: He's landed 2-3 Tongue Lash hits on you
theirWindow.what: His next Q (Tongue Lash) stuns and consumes the stacks, opening a follow-up R (Devour) for a burst kill. If your W (Remove Scurvy) is down, disengage past 900 range until the stacks decay or your W is back up.

yourWindow.when: His W (Abyssal Dive) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: He has no dash to escape or engage from range, so step in and trade with Q (Parrrley) at 625 range plus the Grog-Soaked Blade poison. He can't reset the fight, and any Q stacks he's built are wasted if he can't follow through.

start.why: Sustains you through early Tongue Lash pokes while you look for Parrrley trades; this start is run in 68.9% of games for a reason — it's the highest-sample path by far.

boots.why: Lifesteal keeps you even in extended trades against his Q heal and Thick Skin regen, and the magic resist softens Devour's burst if he lands the stun combo.

core.why: Mana sustain lets you spam Parrrley to poke and build stacks of Grog-Soaked Blade without running dry.
The execute threshold turns your poke damage into kills once he's low from Q trades.
An Acquired Taste scales off his total health, meaning he's building HP to tank you — armor pen cuts straight through that stacking.

situational.when: he's popping thick skin's shield to survive your all-ins, since it shreds the shield he's converting from stored damage
he's consistently landing the three-stack stun and you need a lifeline through the follow-up devour
you're ahead and snowballing, since the crit scaling closes out fights faster than armor shred alone

runes.keystoneWhy: The burn ticks through his Thick Skin regen and Tongue Lash heal, so your poke damage doesn't get fully undone between trades.

summoners.why: Ignite is run in 85.3% of games here for a reason: it punishes his Q heal and Thick Skin sustain directly and secures kills on poke trades before he can stabilize.

playing.title: Count stacks before every trade
playing.detail: Never walk up for a free Parrrley once he's at 2+ stacks of An Acquired Taste — the next Tongue Lash that lands stuns you and opens the door for R (Devour).

playing.title: Hold W for the stun, not chip damage
playing.detail: Remove Scurvy clears the stun outright. Don't burn it for a small heal early if his stacks are building — save it for the exact moment the stun would land.

playing.title: Poke hard when Abyssal Dive is down
playing.detail: Without W he has no dash to engage or escape, so this is your window to walk up and trade freely with Parrrley and auto-attacks.

playing.title: Respect his longer Tongue Lash range
playing.detail: His Q reaches 900 range versus your Q's 625 — don't stand at the edge of your range thinking you're safe, you're still inside his.

playing.title: Watch for the shield pop before all-inning
playing.detail: Thick Skin's active converts stored damage into a shield. If he's been tanking hits without using it, expect a shield the moment you commit — bait it out first if you can.

playing.title: Buy Lord Dominik's Regards on curve
playing.detail: His passive damage and tankiness both scale off total health, so armor penetration is disproportionately valuable here compared to flat damage items.

playing.title: Don't panic at even trades
playing.detail: This matchup sits at 51% over 204 games — it's not lost if he gets a stack or two on you. Just don't let three stacks go unanswered.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and win rates above are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the stack-timing, cooldown-tracking, and trade-pattern reasoning connecting them to the ability text is my own tactical read.

stats.opponentTip: Although Tahm Kench is an easy target to stack up on Grasp of the Undying, be careful of his (Q) when [W] is on cooldown as he will try to kill you then.
